text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kashiwa Kinen— Hokko 
Tarumae, who conquered this race last 
year, was nowhere to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems her stomach is still acting up. 
Even so, she was eager to put on a great 
run alongside Wonder Acute.
